_meta.note: Hand-authored. These constants exist nowhere in the 5eTools corpus as data: the standard array and the point-buy budget are numbers inside English sentences, and the cost table is a rendered table inside a prose entry. 5eTools hardcodes them in its own builder too. See documentation/CHARGEN.md G1.

sources.verified: The cost table was read from variantrules.json -> 'Customizing Ability Scores' -> a type:table entry with colLabels [Score, Cost]. The 27-point budget is prose in the same entry.

sources.note: The 2024 rules keep the same point-buy costs and budget. What changes is where the increases come from: the background carries them, not the species (documentation/CHARGEN.md step 5).

methods.name: Standard array
methods.summary: Assign the six fixed values. Fast, balanced, no luck.

methods.name: Point buy
methods.summary: Spend a budget across the six scores.

methods.name: Roll 4d6
methods.summary: Six rolls, discard the lowest die each time. Swingy.

methods.name: Enter manually
methods.summary: Type the numbers directly. For imported or homebrew characters.

limits.note: 20 is the cap for player characters without magic; 30 is the absolute ceiling the rules allow (documentation/CHARGEN.md step 1).
